scope: Built-in new-game setup (src/DeepFrontier/Scripts/MapSetup, docs/maps.md 'Built-in maps: new-game setup'). The per-map placements, total height, map size and unmet items come from tools/map_variants/*.json (each default variant whose source is builtin:<Name>). tools/map_setup_content.mjs generates Configurations/DeepFrontierMapSetup.blueprint.json and the enUS rows from this file and the variants; tools/prepare_deep_frontier_map.py builtin checks this file against the game and the reference variants.
devMapsWhy: The game's developer test maps (IsDev, empty loc keys; the new-game list shows them only in dev mode). Deep Frontier gives them no setup: a new game on one gets a notification and a log line saying so, and no objects or height. The names are their asset (GameObject) names in resources.assets; prepare_deep_frontier_map.py checks that the sizes match the game's dev maps.

smallMap.why: A built-in map gets the EXTREMELY difficult warning (BuiltinMapSpec.Small) when its area (width x height) is below maxArea, or when its variant lists no primary (non-alternative) site of deepMineSite. maxArea is derived, and checked by prepare_deep_frontier_map.py builtin: the largest area that the full-loop sites claim on a reference map (primary footprints plus their listed open margins, siteArea.withOpenMargins of the built-in validation) divided by landShare. Below it, those sites alone would take more than half of the map, before terrain, water, farms, forest and homes. deepMineSite is the only building that mines deep ore without end (the one building whose understructure is the Deep Ore Vein; prepare_deep_frontier_map.py builtin checks this). Deep ore is required for the late game, and the finite Deep Ore Sources are sized for one of each building, not for the launch program, so a map without a Deep Mine site cannot finish the game whatever its size.

unmetText.why: Player-facing lines for a variant's declared unmet loop items: only items no ordinary play can provide (user 2026-11-01: "No new game notice. People know how to play."). Gaps a player fixes by damming, draining, planting, irrigating, platforms or terraforming are declared "playerWork" instead: met, recorded in the validation evidence and docs/maps.md, no notice; their lines (fishing, farmland, trees, pines) were removed. The variant's 'reason' stays in the JSON, the validation evidence and docs/maps.md. Every missing building site of a map is folded into one line, sites with the buildings' enUS display names; every other item needs its line here, and map_setup_content.mjs fails on an item without one. No built-in map declares an unmet item since 2026-11-01.
unmetText.sites: No ready space for: {0}. Level ground or build on platforms to make room before you need them.

items.Deep Drill sites beside Deep Ore Sources: Deep ore: no ready space for a Deep Drill beside a Deep Ore Source. Level ground next to one so a drill can start your deep industry.
items.finite deep ore covers one of each build: Deep ore: the Deep Ore Sources run out before you can build one of each deep-ore building. Spend it carefully and get a Deep Mine running early.
items.Human Record Caches in survey range of a: Story: no Human Record Caches to survey, so their bonus artifacts and journal entries are missing. The Archive Excavation still digs up artifacts.
items.renewable scrap (Underground Ruins for t: Scrap metal: no reachable Underground Ruins for a Mine, so scrap runs out once the surface ruins are gone. Salvage early and use metal carefully.
